front.title: UTXO Domain Name System (UTXO6-DNS): Data RR for Cryptographic Endpoint Discovery

abstract.t: This document specifies a new DNS Data Resource Record (RRTYPE 260) for transporting opaque cryptographic pointers. The RDATA contains a CBOR-encoded endpoint identifier and an optional Verifiable Random Function (VRF) proof. This document prohibits apex usage and mandates the _utxo prefix.
